selection_protocol: Development uses seed 0 only and three strict-online blocked windows: weeks 1-28 -> 29-36, 1-36 -> 37-44, and 1-44 -> 45-52. Each fold standardizes only its own visible training prefix and is scored after inverse standardization on log1p(weekly admissions per 100,000). Mean Gaussian NLPD selects a configuration; mean RMSE breaks ties. CRPS, ECE and Coverage90 are diagnostics. Formal seeds 5-9 are never read for capacity, checkpoint or online-step selection.

practical_capacity_stability.rule: The two largest passing budgets must differ by no more than 1% RMSE and 0.01 Gaussian NLPD.
practical_capacity_stability.meaning: Pre-specified engineering criterion, not a theoretical capacity guarantee.

routeb_ordinary_vs_cumulative_hippo.rule: Exact match: Route-B ordinary and cumulative HiPPO use the same Kronecker representation and differ only in the temporal state update. Existing formal accuracy archives remain frozen.

bui_osgpr.rule: Controlled and adaptive Bui OSGPR accuracy archives are retained without new capacity tuning. A future hardware timing study may use their documented selected grid, but it does not alter accuracy rows.

ovc_svgp.rule: OVC is selected alone, not by the former Bui/OVC macro-average. Each candidate uses the same time-by-space inducing grid convention; mean Gaussian NLPD, mean RMSE and smaller grid select its own capacity. Two clean-process 32-week memory audits must pass before formal work.

st_svgp.rule: Tune spatial inducing locations only. The official filtering representation is replicated through time and is not semantically comparable with Route-B Mt x Ms. Report the resulting causal-refit runtime separately.

factorial_lmc_imc_fsde.rule: LMC-SVGP, IMC-SVGP and FSDE-SVI use the same selected M,Q pair because their temporal inducing count and latent rank have comparable semantics. Select the shared capacity only after every family member passes each candidate's convergence and causal gates; then select the multi-step online posterior update budget on the same blocked windows.

ohsvgp.rule: Use deterministic seeded RFF frequencies. This is the official OHSVGP core adapted to multidimensional Setting B; the RFF choices are adapter-specific rather than a universal official setup.
